details.artifact_type: replacement GRASS GIS wxPython GUI directory
details.availability: Public Python source that replaces the gui/wxpython directory of an installed GRASS GIS 8.4.

code.reason: The inspected tree has no license or COPYING file and GitHub reports no license. GRASS GIS's own license is not transferred to this copy by inference.

name: grass-gui
notes: The ScienceBoard README lists this repository among its modified applications as the Python GUI part of GRASS GIS. Its manual.md installs GRASS 8.4 from the ubuntugis PPA and swaps this repository in for /usr/lib/grass84/gui/wxpython. At commit 4fe0312, wxgui.py starts a Flask thread on FLASK_PORT (default 8000) with /version, /init/cmd, /init/map, /init/layer, /init/scale, /dump, /gcmd, /gcmdline and /quit routes; /dump reports map layers, layer windows, toolbars, status-bar mode and scale, the region and console output. The rest of the tree is the upstream wxGUI code with its original README. GitHub does not mark the repository as a fork.
summary: ScienceBoard's replacement GRASS GIS 8.4 wxPython GUI with an embedded Flask server that loads mapsets and layers, runs GRASS commands and returns layer, region and console state as JSON for task checks.
